formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua/Water/Eau already one entry; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based). Asterisk markers on Polyimide-1 and Polyquaternium-10 stripped, kept as provenance.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): defining anionic is Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2, ether/sulfonate type), buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) and Coco-Glucoside (11), no prominent reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Olefin sulfonate is a fairly strong cleanser; rich refatting/oil load (7, 8, 14, 16) argues the other way. Neither moves the C1 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High (C2 met via payload-lipid substitution): prominent payload lipids Cocos Nucifera Oil (7) and Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (8) take the early-silicone place; cationic polymers Polyquaternium-10 (13), Polyquaternium-7 (15), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (18); pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (21); humectants Glycerin (5), Panthenol (10). Film former Polyimide-1 (12) and weak refatters (14, 16) add routes. W-RICH also holds.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; all deposition routes sit after Sodium Chloride (6), so each is likely at low level; three light polymers rather than one strong system.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: several converging deposition families (two prominent plant oils, three cationic polymers, a film former, weak refatters) make noticeable residue plausible, but there is no silicone, every route sits after the salt, and an effective buffered olefin-sulfonate chassis gives ordinary reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: Many families converge (payload_lipid 7/8, cationic_polymer 13/15/18, film_former 12, weak_refatter 14/16), but all after salt and no silicone system.

persistence.rationale: Polyquaternium-10/-7 and Polyimide-1 film are moderately persistent; liquid oils at low level are weakly retained in rinse-off.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 olefin sulfonate with betaine and glucoside buffers = effective ordinary chassis.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH is established (prominent oils converging with cationic polymers) but reset is moderate (not limited), so the rich route to high is closed; the converging routes are all low-level, so moderate is best supported.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no silicone, all deposition after salt, effective C1 chassis offsets; not low: four distinct deposition families including two prominent oils and three polymers make lightweight an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: W-RICH with moderate reset; number of converging families argues toward high (N-ALT neighbor high).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims (3.2). Formula care-direction verdict provisional: dual_supported (humectants Glycerin 5/Panthenol 10 plus oils 7/8 and polymers support moisture; oils+polymers+film former give a deposition cluster for repair).

usageRole.rationale: Default; cleansingStrength moderate rules out alternating; frequent possible only with explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met: prominent Panthenol (10) comfort route; Glycerin (5), oils (7, 8), Glyceryl Oleate (16) humectant/refatting routes.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Sodium Salicylate (23) is a preservative and does not qualify.

formulaFacts.role: foam booster, not a cleansing route
